content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

Stripe is operational in only 46 countries, leaving many creators without a reliable payment processing solution. PayPal, while more widely recognized, is fraught with issues such as account suspensions that can freeze funds for up to 180 days without appeal. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a seamless alternative, enabling creators to sell digital products directly to their audience without depending on restrictive platforms. Using tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can establish their payment systems with better control and transparency.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal often restrict access to their services based on geographical location, effectively locking out entire countries from participating in the digital economy. This exclusion is particularly acute in regions like Africa and parts of Asia, where many talented creators reside. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, does not discriminate based on geography. By leveraging decentralized payment solutions and open-source tools, creators can establish their businesses in a resilient manner that is not contingent upon the approval of conventional financial platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed is critical for any digital seller. While PayPal and Stripe may boast quick transactions, the reality is that account complications can lead to delays and frustrations. Moreover, PayPal's fees can accumulate, especially for international transactions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, particularly with NOWPayments, only incurs a low fee of 0.5% with no hidden costs, ensuring that creators retain more of their earnings. The ability to transact in over 300 cryptocurrencies also opens avenues for lower transaction costs, especially on networks like BSC and Solana.
Sovereign infrastructure means complete ownership of your digital commerce.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor often overlooked when using platforms like PayPal or Stripe; users do not truly own their customer data or product distribution channels. Both platforms can revoke access at any time. Sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees complete ownership after deployment, meaning creators are not reliant on third-party services. Automation is another strongpoint; tools like Cloudflare Workers enable instant product delivery and seamless user experiences. This system ensures that once a purchase is made, customers receive their products instantly, eliminating the manual intervention often required by traditional platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Deciding on the right infrastructure depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you are looking for a quick setup with minimal hassle, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) might be suitable. However, for those who require a more robust solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive approach by integrating multiple services for optimal performance. This stack not only streamlines your e-commerce process but also enhances security and reliability, ensuring your business can thrive without the constraints of traditional financial platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the risk of account suspensions that can freeze your funds.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting the right stack for your needs; consider the Edge Commerce Stack for comprehensive functionality. Next, set up your Cloudflare Pages to host your website. Integrate Supabase for order management and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Load your digital products into the system and configure automated delivery methods. Finally, test your setup thoroughly before going live to ensure everything functions seamlessly.
